notes: CONFIRMED live on store.google.com as of 2026-09-13: https://store.google.com/us/product/pixel_10_pro_fold_specs?hl=en-US returns 200 with the full spec table and a 'From $1,799 ... Buy' control, even though the Pixel 11 Pro Fold has taken its place in the store's top navigation. WATCH THE URL: the locale-less https://store.google.com/product/pixel_10_pro_fold_specs?hl=en-US geo-redirected to store.google.com/?hl=es-419 (Mexico home page) and returned no spec content - use the /us/ or /gb/ path. mm dimensions were taken from the en-GB locale page, which prints them natively in mm; NO conversion was performed. The en-US page states only rounded inches for the same device (Folded: 6.1 in x 3 in x 0.4 in; Unfolded: 6.1 in x 5.9 in x 0.2 in; 9.1 oz) - those inch values are far too coarse for CAD and were NOT used or converted. CAMERA-BAR TRAP, checked explicitly: the 'Dimensions and weight' heading does carry a footnote, but its full text is only 'Dimensions and weight vary by configuration and manufacturing process.' Google makes NO statement anywhere on this page about whether the 10.8 mm folded depth includes or excludes the camera bar, so the reference surface for that figure is unknown - do not assume it is the camera-bar peak. Display diagonals: en-US prints '6.4-inch Actua display' and '8-inch Super Actua Flex display'; en-GB prints the same panels as '162 mm' and '8-inch (204 mm)'. refresh_hz 120 is the maximum of Google's stated ranges (cover 60-120 Hz, inner 1-120 Hz). Inner-display aspect ratio left null - Google states one only for the cover (20:9). hinge.crease left NULL: Google calls it a 'gearless hinge' and the dedicated blog.google hinge-design article describes cams and materials but never the crease SHAPE. hinge.free_stop left NULL: neither the spec page nor either blog post documents free-stop or hold-at-any-angle (the spec page's 'Tabletop mode hands-free shots' is a camera feature, not a hinge claim). max_angle_deg left null - not published. hinge.type/axis are the registry's family assignment, corroborated by Google's own folded-vs-unfolded figures. controls[0].position left null: the page lists 'Fingerprint Unlock' but never states where the sensor sits. Google's hinge material statement is 'Multi-alloy steel with an aerospace-grade high-strength aluminum alloy cover'. active_area_mm left null. SUPERSEDED: the Pixel 11 Pro Fold (announced 2026-08-12) is the current Pixel foldable as of 2026-09-13.
